北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光虽好，体感偏凉风力大，注意防寒保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: It's sunny but windy and chilly, remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 天气多云很舒适，微风轻拂，出门游玩好时光！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and pleasant, a gentle breeze, perfect for going out!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 有霾天气，出门请做好防护，注意呼吸道健康。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Hazy weather today, protect yourself outdoors and mind your respiratory health.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光明媚，气温宜人，记得多喝水哦，别晒伤了！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant, remember to hydrate and avoid sunburn!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光正好，气温舒适，适合户外活动，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and comfortable, great for outdoor activities, keep smiling!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 有霾天气，出门记得戴口罩，保护好呼吸道哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hazy conditions, remember to wear a mask outdoors for respiratory protection.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，气温舒适，正是出门散步的好时候呢！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies and pleasant temperatures, perfect for a walk!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 多云无风，气温适中，出门感受一下初春的温柔吧。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and calm with mild temperatures, enjoy the gentle early spring!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温很舒服，微风习习，出门记得添衣哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and comfortable with a light breeze, remember to add a layer!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗干燥，气温略低，多喝水润润喉，谨防感冒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and dry with cooler temps, drink water to stay hydrated and avoid colds.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 有霾且湿润，出门请做好防护，注意通风哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Hazy and humid, please take precautions outdoors and ensure good ventilation.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 晴冷！体感极寒，务必全副武装，暖暖和和过一天。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but extremely cold! Bundle up completely to stay warm all day.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗但严寒，保暖是关键，小心别冻着了哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny but very cold, keeping warm is key, don't catch a chill!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 阳光灿烂，气温宜人，别忘了多补水，享受美好时光。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Bright sunshine and pleasant temperatures, remember to hydrate and enjoy the day.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，气温宜人，微风吹拂，心情也会很好哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and pleasant with a gentle breeze, enjoy your day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 有雾且风大湿冷，务必注意出行安全，增添衣物。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Foggy, windy, and damp cold, take care when traveling and dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云偏冷风力大，外出记得多穿点，小心着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, cold, and windy, remember to layer up when going out to avoid catching a cold.
